summary: Tested KPI Engine (7 KPIs) and PPM Engine features. All 30 backend API tests passed (100%). Frontend verified: Pulse Pro Reports tab shows Performance KPIs dashboard with all 7 KPIs, Faults tab has Reactive/PPM toggle with working PPM management UI.

backend_kpi_dashboard.details: GET /api/reports/kpi-dashboard returns all 7 KPIs with period parameter (7d, 30d, 90d, 365d, all)

backend_ppm_task_completion.details: PATCH /api/ppm/tasks/{id} with status=completed marks task done

backend_issue_patch_kpi_timestamps.details: PATCH /api/issues/{id} accepts engineer_assigned_at, engineer_arrived_at, work_started_at, parts_used, engineer_notes, safety_checks_passed

backend_pulse_user_access.details: Pulse Pro user can access KPI dashboard, PPM summary, and PPM tasks

frontend_pulse_reports_kpi_tab.details: Reports tab shows 'Performance KPIs' as first sub-tab with full KPI dashboard

frontend_pulse_kpi_dashboard.details: KPI dashboard shows all 4 summary cards (PPM Compliance, Avg Downtime, Safety SLA, Equipment Availability) with ratings

frontend_pulse_kpi_details.details: Detailed sections visible: PPM Compliance breakdown, Reactive Response Times, Safety & Inspection Compliance, Worst Performing Assets

frontend_pulse_faults_ppm_toggle.details: Faults tab has 'Reactive Faults' / 'Planned Maintenance (PPM)' toggle buttons

frontend_pulse_ppm_subtab.details: PPM sub-tab shows summary cards (Active Schedules, Upcoming, Completed, Overdue, Compliance), task list with Complete buttons, schedule management

critical_code_review_comments: KPI calculations are well-structured with proper organization filtering
PPM engine correctly handles schedule frequencies (weekly, monthly, quarterly, biannual, annual)
Issue PATCH endpoint properly handles both status-only and KPI timestamp updates
Frontend KPI dashboard uses CSS variables for theming (works in both dark GymAxis and light Pulse Pro)
All data-testid attributes properly implemented for testing
